units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of industrial safety, federal state supervision in the field of hydraulic structure safety, and federal state mining supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to mine-surveying marks and signs of sanitary (mining-sanitary) zones and districts), part 2 of Article 7.3 (with respect to violation of the requirements of a technical project approved under the established procedure for the safe conduct of work related to subsoil use, as well as plans and schemes for the development of mining operations), Article 7.4 (with respect to failure to meet requirements for preserving buildings and structures when using subsoil), Article 7.7 (with respect to damage to hydraulic structures, except navigational hydraulic structures), parts 1 and 2 of Article 8.7 (with respect to failure to perform or untimely performance of land reclamation duties when developing mineral deposits, including common minerals, except agricultural land), part 2 of Article 8.10, parts 1 and 3 of Article 8.17, Article 8.19 (within its powers), Article 8.39 (concerning administrative offences committed in sanitary (mining-sanitary) zones and districts), parts 1 and 2, part 3 (with respect to gross violation of industrial safety requirements), and parts 3.1 and 4 of Article 9.1, part 1 of Article 9.1.1, Article 9.2 (except navigational hydraulic structures), Article 9.10 (except cases of damage to heat networks or their equipment), Article 9.19, part 7 of Article 9.22, Article 10.10 (with respect to hydraulic structures, except navigational hydraulic structures), parts 2 and 3 of Article 11.6 (except navigational hydraulic structures), Article 11.14 (with respect to the carriage of dangerous substances), Articles 11.20, 11.20.1 and 14.26, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Article 14.44, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, Article 14.61 (with respect to violation of the established procedure for providing security for the performance of obligations to pay for gas, coupled with failure to perform (improper performance of) the obligations to pay for it), Article 19.2, part 11 of Article 19.5, and part 1 of Article 19.22 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of industrial safety, federal state supervision in the field of hydraulic structure safety, and federal state mining supervision, and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of industrial safety, federal state supervision in the field of hydraulic structure safety, and federal state mining supervision, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: 3) state inspectors of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of industrial safety, federal state supervision in the field of hydraulic structure safety, and federal state mining supervision;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: 4) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of industrial safety, federal state supervision in the field of hydraulic structure safety, and federal state mining supervision, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: 5) heads of departments, deputy heads of departments, chief state inspectors, senior state inspectors and state inspectors of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of industrial safety, federal state supervision in the field of hydraulic structure safety, and federal state mining supervision.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.31. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Industrial Safety, Federal State Supervision in the Field of Hydraulic Structure Safety, and Federal State Mining Supervision
units.text: 3. The officials specified in items 1 and 4 of part 2 of this Article shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3, 3.1 and 4 of Article 9.1 and Article 11.20.1 of this Code on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23.31

units.locator: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.text: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.label: Art. 23.33

units.locator: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.label: Art. 23.33

units.locator: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of use of atomic energy shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 12 of Article 7.30.3 (with respect to products and processes for which requirements related to ensuring safety in the field of use of atomic energy are established), Article 8.5 (with respect to concealment or distortion of environmental information on the radiation situation), Article 9.6, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, Article 19.2, and part 17 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.33

units.locator: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.33

units.locator: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of use of atomic energy and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.33

units.locator: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of use of atomic energy and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.33

units.locator: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.text: 3) chief state inspectors of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of use of atomic energy;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.33

units.locator: Article 23.33. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Use of Atomic Energy
units.text: 4) heads of departments, deputy heads of departments, chief state inspectors, senior state inspectors and state inspectors of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of use of atomic energy.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.33

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising federal state fire supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 6.24, 6.25, 8.32, 8.32.3 and 11.16, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, and Article 20.4 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences and impose administrative penalties on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Fire Supervision and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 2) chief state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for fire supervision and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 3) chief state inspectors of cities (districts) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for fire supervision and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 3.1) chief state inspectors of territorial, facility-based, special and military units of the federal fire service for fire supervision and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 4) state inspectors of the Russian Federation for fire supervision;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 5) state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for fire supervision;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 6) state inspectors of cities (districts) of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for fire supervision;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 7) state inspectors of territorial, facility-based, special and military units of the federal fire service for fire supervision;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 8) the head of the structural division of the federal executive authority exercising federal state fire supervision in forests when exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection), and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 9) the head of the structural division of the federal executive authority exercising federal state fire supervision at underground mining sites and during the production, transportation, storage, disposal and use of industrial explosives when exercising federal state supervision in the field of industrial safety and federal state mining supervision, and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 10) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state fire supervision in forests and their deputies;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 11) chief state inspectors for fire supervision of the federal executive authority in the field of security, in the sphere of defence, National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, internal affairs, state protection, foreign intelligence, or mobilisation preparation and mobilisation, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 12) state inspectors for fire supervision of the federal executive authority in the field of security, in the sphere of defence, National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, internal affairs, state protection, foreign intelligence, or mobilisation preparation and mobilisation;
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 13) chief state inspectors for fire supervision of operational-territorial formations of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 13 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 14) state inspectors for fire supervision of operational-territorial formations of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 14 Part 2 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.34. Authorities Exercising Federal State Fire Supervision
units.text: 3. The officials specified in items 5 - 7 of part 2 of this Article shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences committed by citizens and officials.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23.34

units.locator: Article 23.35. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Supervision of the Technical Condition of Self-Propelled Machines and Other Types of Equipment
units.text: Article 23.35. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Supervision of the Technical Condition of Self-Propelled Machines and Other Types of Equipment
units.label: Art. 23.35

units.locator: Article 23.35. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Supervision of the Technical Condition of Self-Propelled Machines and Other Types of Equipment
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.35. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Supervision of the Technical Condition of Self-Propelled Machines and Other Types of Equipment
units.label: Art. 23.35

units.locator: Article 23.35. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Supervision of the Technical Condition of Self-Propelled Machines and Other Types of Equipment
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state supervision of the technical condition of self-propelled machines and other types of equipment shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22 and 8.23 (with respect to equipment subject to supervision by those authorities), Article 9.3, Article 12.37 (with respect to equipment subject to supervision by those authorities), parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Article 14.44, and part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to equipment subject to supervision by those authorities) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.35

units.locator: Article 23.35. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Supervision of the Technical Condition of Self-Propelled Machines and Other Types of Equipment
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.35

units.locator: Article 23.35. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Supervision of the Technical Condition of Self-Propelled Machines and Other Types of Equipment
units.text: 1) chief state engineer-inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for supervision of the technical condition of self-propelled machines and other types of equipment and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.35

units.locator: Article 23.35. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Supervision of the Technical Condition of Self-Propelled Machines and Other Types of Equipment
units.text: 2) chief state engineer-inspectors of cities and districts for supervision of the technical condition of self-propelled machines and other types of equipment and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.35

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 6.24, Article 6.25, Article 7.7 (with respect to navigational hydraulic structures), Articles 8.22 and 8.23, Article 9.2 (with respect to navigational hydraulic structures), Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of transport infrastructure facilities and passenger transport services in the fields of railway transport, inland water transport, road transport and urban surface electric transport), Article 10.10 (with respect to navigational hydraulic structures), Articles 11.1, 11.6 - 11.6.3, 11.7, 11.8 - 11.11 and 11.13, parts 2 and 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.14.2, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 11.14.3, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1, part 1 of Article 11.15.2, Article 11.16, part 5 of Article 11.17, Articles 11.23, 11.26, 11.27, 11.29, 11.31, 11.33 and 12.21.1 - 12.21.5, parts 4 and 6 of Article 12.23, parts 2 and 4 of Article 12.25, Article 12.31.1, parts 1 - 6 of Article 13.19.5, parts 1 - 6 of Article 13.19.6, Article 14.4.4, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43.1, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, part 10 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.5, part 1 of Article 19.7.9, part 2 of Article 19.22 (except state registration of small vessels used for non-commercial purposes), and part 1 of Article 20.25 (with respect to failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or by Chapter 12 of this Code, committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: 1) in road transport and road management — the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, and other officials of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision who are authorised to exercise federal state transport supervision (state transport inspectors) — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 6.24, Articles 6.25, 8.22 and 8.23, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of road transport and urban surface electric transport facilities and passenger transport services in the fields of road transport and urban surface electric transport), Article 11.14.2, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 11.14.3, Articles 11.15, 11.23, 11.26, 11.27, 11.29, 11.31, 11.33 and 12.21.1 - 12.21.5, parts 4 and 6 of Article 12.23, parts 2 and 4 of Article 12.25, Article 12.31.1, parts 1 - 6 of Article 13.19.5, parts 1 - 6 of Article 13.19.6, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, and part 1 of Article 20.25 (with respect to failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or by Chapter 12 of this Code, committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: 2) in maritime transport — the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, and other officials of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision who are authorised to exercise federal state transport supervision (state transport inspectors) — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 6.24, Articles 6.25, 8.22, 8.23, 11.6 - 11.6.3, 11.7, 11.8 - 11.11 and 11.13, part 2 of Article 11.14, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 11.14.3, Articles 11.15 and 11.16, part 5 of Article 11.17, Article 11.31, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, and part 2 of Article 19.22 (except state registration of small vessels used for non-commercial purposes) of this Code; seaport harbour masters — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 11.6 - 11.6.3, 11.7, 11.8 - 11.11 and 11.13, part 2 of Article 11.14, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 11.14.3, Articles 11.15 and 11.16, part 5 of Article 11.17, Article 11.31, and part 2 of Article 19.22 (except state registration of small vessels used for non-commercial purposes) of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: 3) in inland water transport — the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, and other officials of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision who are authorised to exercise federal state transport supervision (state transport inspectors) — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 6.24, Article 6.25, Article 7.7 (with respect to navigational hydraulic structures), Articles 8.22 and 8.23, Article 9.2 (with respect to navigational hydraulic structures), Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of inland water transport facilities and passenger transport services in the field of inland water transport), Article 10.10 (with respect to navigational hydraulic structures), Articles 11.6, 11.6.2, 11.7, 11.8 - 11.11 and 11.13, part 2 of Article 11.14, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 11.14.3, Articles 11.15 and 11.16, part 5 of Article 11.17, Article 11.31, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, and parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2 of this Code; masters of inland waterway basins of the Russian Federation — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 11.6, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 11.7, Articles 11.8 and 11.9 - 11.11, part 1 of Article 11.13, part 2 of Article 11.14, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 11.14.3, Articles 11.15 and 11.16, part 5 of Article 11.17, Article 11.31, and part 2 of Article 19.22 (except state registration of small vessels used for non-commercial purposes) of this Code;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: 4) on public and non-public railway transport — the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, and other officials of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision who are authorised to exercise federal state transport supervision (state transport inspectors) — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 6.24, Article 6.25, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of railway transport facilities and passenger transport services in the field of railway transport), Article 11.1, part 3 of Article 11.14, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 11.14.3, Articles 11.15, 11.16, 11.31 and 14.4.4, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, and parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2 of this Code;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Transport Supervision
units.text: 5) in the field of ensuring transport security — the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision, their deputies, and other officials of the federal executive authority exercising federal state transport supervision who are authorised to exercise federal state transport supervision (state transport inspectors) — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 11.15.1, part 1 of Article 11.15.2, part 10 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.5, and part 1 of Article 19.7.9 of this Code.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.36

units.locator: Article 23.36.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Passenger Taxi
units.text: Article 23.36.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Passenger Taxi
units.label: Art. 23.36.1

units.locator: Article 23.36.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Passenger Taxi
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.36.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Passenger Taxi
units.label: Art. 23.36.1

units.locator: Article 23.36.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Passenger Taxi
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control in the sphere of passenger and baggage carriage by passenger taxi shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 9.13 and 11.14.1, part 3 of Article 11.31 and Article 12.31.1 (with respect to passenger taxis) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.36.1

units.locator: Article 23.36.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Passenger Taxi
units.text: 2. Heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control in the sphere of passenger and baggage carriage by passenger taxi and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.36.1

units.locator: Article 23.36.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Road Transport and Urban Surface Electric Transport
units.text: Article 23.36.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Road Transport and Urban Surface Electric Transport
units.label: Art. 23.36.2

units.locator: Article 23.36.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Road Transport and Urban Surface Electric Transport
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.36.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Road Transport and Urban Surface Electric Transport
units.label: Art. 23.36.2

units.locator: Article 23.36.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Road Transport and Urban Surface Electric Transport
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising state control in the sphere of passenger and baggage carriage by road transport and urban surface electric transport shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 11.33 of this Code where agreements between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation provide for the transfer of the exercise of those powers.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.36.2

units.locator: Article 23.36.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising State Control in the Sphere of Passenger and Baggage Carriage by Road Transport and Urban Surface Electric Transport
units.text: 2. Heads or deputy heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.36.2
